class.name: MotionBlurEffect
class.brief_description: Smears what moves across the screen along its motion.
class.description: What moves across the screen (the camera turning, a car racing past) is smeared along its motion over [member shutter] of the frame, from the renderer's motion vectors, as a film camera's exposure does. Add it to a [Compositor]'s [member Compositor.compositor_effects], on a [WorldEnvironment] or [Camera3D]. It's drawn after the scene's see-through objects, before tonemapping, in each view (both eyes in VR), with the Forward+ renderer; with the others it draws nothing. In a headset, motion blur the player didn't cause makes many people sick: leave it out of the compositor used in VR.

members.member: The longest smear, as a share of the screen's width, so a sudden turn doesn't blur the whole picture.
How many times each pixel is sampled along its motion. More is smoother and costs more.
The share of each frame's motion that's smeared: [code]0.5[/code] is a film camera's 180-degree shutter, [code]1.0[/code] smears the whole of it.
